bundle.shortDescription: Offline Markdown editor with per-note encryption
bundle.longDescription: Markseal is a local-first, offline Markdown editor. Notes and their images can be encrypted one by one with AES-256-GCM and Argon2id. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.
